frontmatter.title: Building a Real-Time Chat App with MERN Stack and Socket.IO
frontmatter.subheading: What actually works in production, what breaks, and why most “tutorial chat apps” wouldn't survive real users
frontmatter.excerpt: A brutally honest deep dive into building a real-time chat application using the MERN stack and Socket.IO. Covers architecture, scaling, data modeling, authentication, common pitfalls, and production-ready decisions-based on real-world constraints, not toy tutorials.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
